items.title: ZehenSync
items.summary: ZehenSync: a multimodal screening-support platform for mental health, built for patients, psychologists and psychology students. It screens and never diagnoses — a licensed psychologist makes every call.
items.summary_cn: ZehenSync：一个多模式心理健康筛查支持平台，专为患者、心理学家和心理学学生打造。它只进行筛查，绝不做出诊断——每次判断都由持证心理师做出。

items.summary: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. items.title: All the questions Nvidia should answer on Tuesday — but probably won’t
